assets.prompt: BRINE underwater station-builder marine scenery sprite. Unequal branching lengths, airy gaps, broad low overhead footprint. Distinct from long ribbon kelp, fine green seagrass and pale feather hydroids. Near-direct overhead orthographic camera, shallow relief, diffuse neutral lighting, tactile restrained detailed game art.
